title: Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)
description: Use this service request to report non-hazardous problems with traffic signs in need of maintenance, i.e. faded, damaged, knocked down, etc. Signs include street name blades, school crossing, dip, no parking, speed limit, etc. Signs for businesses or parking lots are the owner's responsiility. ** Please call 3-1-1 if a STOP, ONE WAY or YIELD sign is down or to report a Radar Feedback Sign issue. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a nonhazardous City traffic-sign problem.
actions.why: For a faded, damaged, knocked-down, leaning, missing, graffiti-covered, or obscured City roadway sign other than a downed stop, one-way, or yield sign. Examples include street-name, school-crossing, no-parking, and speed-limit signs. The 311 request form asks for sign location and type, problem, timing, and direction.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)" requests does not apply to signs owned by a building or parking lot, a downed stop, yield, or one-way sign, or a radar-feedback sign issue. If a stop, yield, or one-way sign is down, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online. If a radar-feedback sign has a problem, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a downed stop, yield, or one-way sign.
actions.why: For a fallen stop, yield, or one-way sign, including a street-name blade with an attached stop sign that has been knocked down. The Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other) description and form direct this urgent sign condition to 311 by phone.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a radar-feedback sign problem.
actions.why: For an issue with a radar-feedback sign. The Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other) description and its Other sign-type guidance direct people to call 3-1-1.
